name: kmod

commands.command:
mkdir -p build
cd       build

meson setup --prefix=/usr ..    \
            --buildtype=release \
            -D manpages=false

description: The Kmod package contains libraries and utilities for loading kernel modules

installed_descriptions.name: depmod
installed_descriptions.description: Creates a dependency file based on the symbols it finds in the existing set of modules; this dependency file is used by modprobe to automatically load the required modules

installed_descriptions.name: insmod
installed_descriptions.description: Installs a loadable module in the running kernel

installed_descriptions.name: modinfo
installed_descriptions.description: Examines an object file associated with a kernel module and displays any information that it can glean

installed_descriptions.name: modprobe
installed_descriptions.description: Uses a dependency file, created by depmod, to automatically load relevant modules

installed_descriptions.name: rmmod
installed_descriptions.description: Unloads modules from the running kernel

installed_descriptions.name: libkmod
installed_descriptions.description: This library is used by other programs to load and unload kernel modules
